title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop for macOS and Windows
summary: DeepSeek has released native desktop applications for macOS and Windows, bringing their AI assistant to desktop platforms with a dedicated application experience beyond the web interface.
problem_solved: Provides a native desktop experience for accessing DeepSeek's AI assistant with better performance and system integration compared to web browsers.
why_valuable: Desktop applications offer improved stability, faster access, system tray functionality, and potentially better resource management for AI interactions.
